name: ai-vc-skills
description: AI VC skills for Claude Code: exact startup equity math (Paul Graham's equity equation, option pools, SAFEs and notes in a priced round, dilution, vesting, exit waterfalls, a founder's check of their own raise before a VC sees it, runway on a phased plan, traction metrics, a market size built bottom-up, a priced round set beside a convertible note, the option pool a hiring plan needs beside a term sheet's ask, the room left in a round with the term sheets a funnel is expected to give, and a founder's cap table tied out against itself), plus founder-side reviews of a raise (the deck, messaging, claims, the competition map, partner meeting, product decisions, round size, term sheet, diligence, metrics, market size, the champion's memo and updates to current and prospective investors), each with an adversarial review, and founder-side help planning the raise from the founder's own investor list, drafting intro emails, debriefing VC passes, sizing the option pool from a hiring plan and tying out the cap table before an investor's lawyers do, as agent skills with an MCP server.
